messages.text: Just as a few people have been asking. Is there any types of leagues people would like to run and I can put the structure together.  DM me

messages.author: MattyA
messages.text: Dear God my Carolina hurricanes are sucking so bad against the capitals tonight...,. That I truly think alien abductions have taken place.

messages.author: MattyA
messages.text: It's so bad that this West Virginia boy is switching back and forth to the pitt / Virginia tech game and actually pulling for pitt

messages.author: MattyA
messages.text: This is a true delineation of the state of West Virginia. All West Virginians know that WVU football reign supreme gods of college football, so then it just boils down to who do you hate the worst then we'll want to see lose at any cost.. pittt or Virginia tech

messages.author: GMDS
messages.text: pitt v va tech , where does does w penn gms loyalty go?

messages.author: MattyA
messages.text: Oh no it's not where they're loyalty goes.. it's to wear the loyalty lies for all true West Virginians. If you are from Southern West virginia, as I am, we hate Virginia tech so much that we would even root for pit to beat them. And if we saw pitt on fire in the streets we put them out with gasoline

messages.author: GMDS
messages.text: but isnt puss jr at VT?

messages.author: MattyA
messages.text: Oh yes,...... It is the silence. Of frenemies when they play for us as W members

messages.author: MattyA
messages.text: Well I appreciate the the two goals tonight, this just does not look like a brind'amour coached team

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text: AON pulled a muscle in his neck

messages.author: MattyA
messages.text: I truly hope that these Virginia tech fans are paying royalties to West Virginia for that slogan

messages.author: MattyA
messages.text: Also guys, I am at the hospital with a friend who had cancer resection surgery yesterday, and I should be back to the house around 4:00 or so this afternoon. I've already got a game lined up with @Unholy upon my return to the house so I will be looking for at least one more series today if not two more..... One after unholy and I play and then one more if I can get it in before the start of the Canes game and then one after the Canes game

messages.author: MattyA
messages.text: If you are interested, DM me and I'll get it scheduled on my end

messages.author: MattyA
messages.text: And of course I will have the Atlanta Braves playing in the background, along with all other MLB playoff series today
